A few things
worth knowing.

Do I need to know about Web3? +

No. The Carnival brings together curious newcomers, experienced builders, founders and investors. Explore the tracks to find your starting point.

When and where is the next edition? +

The source website does not confirm a future date or location. This redesign shows the next edition as to be announced. Contact the organisers for the latest information.

Is my Carnival Passport a ticket? +

No. It is a personal discovery plan created in this prototype. Your selected interests stay in your browser. No booking, payment or registration is submitted. You can download your plan or open an email enquiry to the organisers.

How can I speak, sponsor or volunteer? +

Use the involvement links to prepare an email enquiry, or book a call with the organisers. Availability and application requirements are confirmed directly by the team.

Privacy & credits

This is an independent design prototype. It is not the official Web3 Carnival booking platform.

Your information

Track selections and theme preference are stored only in this browser. Name and email are kept temporarily in the current form, are not transmitted, and are cleared when the preview closes. Email enquiries open your mail app for you to review and send.

Content & imagery

The Web3 Carnival logo, Threeway Studio mark, speaker portraits, event artwork, community imagery, historical figures and original factual listings come from web3carnival.world ↗. Historical roles are not claims of current employment. Photography is reused as brand imagery and is not attributed to a specific event. Partner names are typographic identifiers, not recreated logos. Layout, copywriting, interactions and the colourful notebook styling are proposed redesign decisions.
